entries.name: Glute Bridge
entries.reason: Own drawn frames on Family 29 supine chain (spine 24.00, neck 9.00, thigh 18.03, shin 19.72 exact); the lifted bridge trunk sits 120 degrees off vertical so the L3 upright rule never claims the bent knee. Full notes and open questions in the daily review.
entries.summary: Five drawn positions of a glute bridge.

frames.caption: Lie on the back with the feet planted close to the fingertips.
Tuck the pelvis before anything else moves.
Drive the floor away through the planted heels.
Hold level hips at the top between knees and shoulders.
Lower on a slow count with the hips level.
